source: Bordik Med — bedside procedural reference для NICU nursing + feldsher (audit Ж1-3, З1-3)
license: Образовательный материал. Каждое процедурное руководство ссылается на institutional NICU protocol.

steps.title: Подготовка
items: Newborn-size mask: правильный размер (cover nose + mouth, не глаза)
Self-inflating bag (Ambu) ИЛИ flow-inflating bag ИЛИ T-piece (Neopuff)
PEEP valve attached если flow-inflating / T-piece

steps.title: Position
items: Sniffing position (нейтральная шея с лёгким разгибанием)
Shoulder roll если нужен (особенно у больших babies)

steps.title: Mask fit
items: C+E grip: thumb + index = C around mask, остальные 3 = E под jaw
Mask seal без leak (слышен hiss = поправить)
НЕ нажимать сильно на trachea (compresses airway)

steps.title: Ventilate
items: PEEP 5 см H₂O (если on PEEP valve)

steps.title: Verify ventilation
items: Если нет rise: M-R SOPA (mask, reposition, suction, open mouth, pressure ↑, alternative airway)

warnings: Excessive pressure (> 30 см H₂O) — pneumothorax risk
Excessive volume — barotrauma
НЕ ventilate новорождённого при наличии активного withdrawal (например, DCC ≥ 60 sec у term)
Если apnea > 30 sec несмотря adequate PPV — call for help, prepare intubation
references: Aziz K et al. Pediatrics 2021;147:e2020038505E — NRP 8 ed.

steps.title: Подготовка
items: Suction catheter правильного размера: 6 Fr (preterm), 8 Fr (term), 10 Fr (large term)

steps.title: Indication только при obstruction
items: Insufficient ventilation несмотря good mask seal
НЕ routine у asymptomatic newborn (даже после meconium staining у vigorous infant)

steps.title: Procedure
items: Mouth first, затем nose (avoid stimulating gag reflex first)
Insert catheter без suction (depth: к pharynx — около 5 см у term)
Apply suction только при withdrawal (rotating motion)

steps.title: Меконий-staining (NRP 8 ed.)
items: Vigorous (good cry/tone, HR > 100): НЕ tracheal suctioning routinely
Non-vigorous (apnea/poor tone/HR < 100): standard PPV first; intubate + tracheal suction только если PPV не effective

warnings: Vagal stimulation → bradycardia при deep / aggressive suctioning
Mucosal trauma + nosebleed
Hypoxia от prolonged suction
НЕ routine deep tracheal suction (NRP 8 ed. изменено с 2015)
references: AARC Clinical Practice Guideline — Endotracheal Suctioning

steps.title: Site selection
items: Avoid: feet (если crawling age), areas of skin damage

steps.title: Position + comfort
items: Skin-to-skin или held by parent если возможно
Pacifier + sucrose 0.5 мл oral 2 мин до procedure

steps.title: Procedure
items: Skin prep с chlorhexidine, allow dry
Stretch skin distal к insertion site
Insert needle bevel up at 10-30° angle
Advance until flash of blood в hub
Reduce angle, advance catheter (NOT needle) over needle
Flush с 0.5-1 мл NS slowly — verify patency (no swelling, no resistance)

warnings: Extravasation — frequent assessment q1h; severe agents (Ca gluconate, hyperosmolar TPN, vasopressors) НЕ peripheral
Air embolism при flush с воздухом
Phlebitis — early sign change site
Thrombosis — assess pulse distal к catheter daily

steps.title: Подготовка
items: Polyurethane preferred (less trauma vs PVC, но более expensive)
pH paper если available (verify gastric placement)

steps.title: Measure depth
items: NEX method: nose → earlobe → xiphoid + 1 cm
У ELBW: NEMU (nose → ear → mid-umbilicus) более accurate (Ellett 2011)

steps.title: Insertion
items: Insert в одну ноздрю slowly (не force)
Stop если resistance — try other ноздрю
Watch for cyanosis / coughing / vomiting (withdraw if persistent)
Secure с tape (avoid pulling on cheek)

steps.title: Verification — perform BEFORE feeding/medication
items: Aspirate gastric contents — pH ≤ 5.5 (gastric); pH > 5.5 ambiguous
X-ray confirmation для feeding tube — gold standard, но не routine после first placement
Re-verify pH перед каждым feeding если bedside available

steps.title: Maintenance
items: Replace q72h ИЛИ per institutional protocol
Flush с 1-2 мл of водой between meds + feedings
Aspirate slowly с 5-10 мл syringe (большие — vacuum trauma)

warnings: Misplacement в trachea / lungs — dangerous (verify pH or X-ray)
Esophageal perforation rare но возможна
Vagal stimulation → bradycardia
Aspiration risk при wrong placement
references: Ellett ML et al. J Pediatr Nurs 2011;26:329 — NEMU method

steps.title: Frequency
items: Stable term newborn: q4h первые 24 ч, затем q8h

steps.title: Heart rate (HR)
items: Bradycardia < 100 — assess for cause + inform physician
Tachycardia > 180 — fever, pain, dehydration, sepsis, CHF

steps.title: Respiratory rate (RR)
items: Tachypnea > 60 sustained — RDS, sepsis, CHF, cold stress
Bradypnea < 30 — apnea risk, sedation, neuro injury
Periodic breathing (pauses < 10 sec без bradycardia/desat) — normal

steps.title: Temperature
items: Axillary (preferred, safest) ИЛИ rectal (если more accurate needed)
Skin probe servo-control когда in incubator

steps.title: Blood pressure
items: NIBP cuff: правильный размер (cuff width = 1/2 окружности arm)
Routine: 1-2 раза/d у stable term; q4h у NICU; continuous arterial line у critical
Normal MAP ≈ GA в нед (e.g., 30 нед PMA → MAP ≥ 30)
Higher MAP target у HIE / cardiac issues

steps.title: SpO₂ targets
items: Pre-ductal preferred (right hand) для CCHD screening
Continuous monitoring у all NICU patients

warnings: Crying / agitation → falsely elevated HR / RR — recheck after settled
Cold extremity → SpO₂ probe poor signal — reposition или warm
Tight cuff → falsely high BP
Sepsis может presenting только subtle vital signs change — high index suspicion

steps.title: Frequency (по риску)
items: High risk (IDM, LGA, SGA, asphyxia): q30 мин first 2 ч, then q1-2h × 12 ч
Moderate risk (late preterm, no feed established): q1-2h × 12 ч, q3-4h до 48 ч

steps.title: Подготовка
items: Sterile lancet (depth 1 mm preterm; 2 mm term)

steps.title: Site selection
items: Lateral or medial PLANTAR aspect heel (avoid posterior heel — calcaneus)

steps.title: Stick procedure
items: Clean site с alcohol — let dry
Brief, single, decisive stick at 90° к skin
Allow large second drop без squeezing (squeeze contaminates with tissue fluid → falsely low)
Direct pressure с gauze post-stick × 30 sec

steps.title: Action thresholds
items: < 1.7 ммоль/л symptomatic ИЛИ < 1.4 asymptomatic первые 4 ч → confirm + treat
Always confirm POC < 2.5 with serum lab

warnings: Squeeze foot — falsely low glucose (tissue fluid)
Repeated sticks same site — bruising, calcaneal injury
POC glucometers overestimate low values у polycythemia + дегидратации
Pain — use analgesia (sucrose ± skin-to-skin)
references: Thornton PS et al. J Pediatr 2015;167:238 — PES 2015

steps.title: Equipment
items: LED phototherapy unit (preferred — wavelength 460-490 nm, low heat)

steps.title: Setup
items: Distance light source: 35-50 cm (LED) или 50 cm (conventional)
Cover eyes carefully (НЕ обмотать слишком туго — corneal abrasion risk)
Reposition q2h: front, back, side для uniform exposure

steps.title: Maintenance care
items: Continue feeding — НЕ stop unless TSB > exchange threshold
Skin-to-skin OK для 30-60 мин при breaks (eye shields off briefly)
Monitor T core (overheating risk if not LED)
Hydration assessment — dry skin, fontanelle, urine output

steps.title: Monitoring TSB
items: Repeat TSB q4-6h в active phase
Stop когда TSB < 2 мг/дл below PT threshold
Recheck TSB в 12-24 ч after stop (rebound risk)

warnings: Eye damage если shield слишком туго (corneal abrasion) или slips off (retinal damage)
Hyperthermia если не-LED + close distance
Dehydration — increased insensible water losses (IWL) ~10-20 % above baseline
НЕ phototherapy при cholestasis (direct hyperbilirubinemia) — "bronze baby syndrome"
Skin photo-darkening transient — не concerning
references: Kemper AR et al. Pediatrics 2022;150(3):e2022058859 — AAP 2022

steps.title: Prong sizing
items: Правильный размер: prong fills nare без stretching skin
Too large — pressure necrosis nasal septum

steps.title: Positioning
items: Prongs angled slightly downward (follows nasal passage anatomy)
Tape / Tegaderm к cheeks для secure без traction
Avoid pulling prongs deep — septum trauma

steps.title: Maintenance
items: Inspect nares + septum q2-4h (rotate prong slightly)
Saline drops 1-2 капли q4-6h prn для secretions
Gentle suction prn (но не routine — irritates mucosa)
Skin protective barrier (Mepilex Lite, Cavilon spray)

steps.title: Skin checks
items: Septum: redness, blanching, breakdown — early signs critical
При первых признаках — rotate prongs, change taping technique, reduce pressure if possible

warnings: Septal necrosis / column deformity — common iatrogenic injury (5-25 % CPAP infants without rotation/protective)
Nasal obstruction → CPAP failure
Air leak from mouth → ineffective CPAP (consider chin strap, pacifier)
Gastric distention — vent G-tube или OG tube placed for decompression
references: Sweet DG et al. Neonatology 2023;120:3 — European Consensus RDS

steps.title: Indications
items: Bilirubin (TcB не replace serum в high-risk)

steps.title: Equipment
items: Sterile lancet (depth 1 mm preterm; 2 mm term)

steps.title: Site selection
items: Lateral or medial PLANTAR aspect heel (avoid posterior — calcaneus)

steps.title: Procedure
items: Sucrose 0.5 мл oral 2 мин до stick
Clean site с alcohol; let dry
Brief, single, decisive stick at 90° к skin
Allow large second drop без squeezing (squeeze contaminates)

warnings: Squeeze foot — falsely low values (tissue fluid contamination)
Repeated sticks same site — bruising, calcaneal injury
Vagal stimulation → bradycardia rare
Pain — use analgesia всегда (sucrose ± skin-to-skin)
Calcaneal osteomyelitis (rare) при deep stick через bone
references: AAP Pediatric Heel Stick Best Practices 2024

steps.title: Methods
items: Axillary (preferred — safest у newborn): thermometer × 3-5 min
Rectal (more accurate когда needed) — DO NOT routine у preterm
Tympanic — НЕ для newborn (small ear canal)

steps.title: Frequency
items: Stable term: q4h × first 24h, then q8h

steps.title: Hypothermia management
items: T < 36.5 → assess + warm (skin-to-skin, plastic wrap, incubator T ↑)
T < 36.0 → moderate hypothermia — incubator + warming protocol
T < 35.5 → severe — pre-warmed transport, sepsis workup

warnings: Rectal probes у preterm — perforation risk; use carefully
Mercury thermometers obsolete — environmental risk
Crying / agitation → falsely elevated
Cold extremity (peripheral) → poor SpO₂ probe signal — reposition

steps.title: 5 rights (always check)
items: RIGHT dose (mg/kg or mg total — recalculate weight)

steps.title: Dose calculation neonate
items: Always по weight — re-confirm latest weight
Most NICU drugs: mg/kg/dose × frequency = total daily
Round to nearest 0.05 мл (50 µл precision needed)
Use 1 мл insulin syringe для precise small volumes
Double-check высокого риска drugs (insulin, heparin, morphine, vasopressors) — independent двух RNs

steps.title: IV preparation
items: Label с: drug, dose, concentration, time prepared, expiry

steps.title: IV administration
items: Verify line patency (gentle flush с saline)
Check compatibility если multi-drugs same line
Slow IV push (over 5+ мин) для most drugs у newborn
Continuous infusion: programmable pump (NEVER drip-set without pump у newborn)
Volume tracking — small volumes (< 1 мл) require special technique (T-piece, syringe pump)

steps.title: PO/NG administration
items: Oral syringe (NOT IV syringe — accidental IV risk)
Flush NG с 1-2 мл воды after
Verify NG placement pH ≤ 5.5 BEFORE every dose

steps.title: IM injection
items: Vastus lateralis (anterior thigh — preferred у newborn)
Pre-medication sucrose 0.5 мл oral 2 мин до

warnings: 10x dose errors common у newborn — always verify decimals (0.5 vs 5.0)
Heparin / insulin / morphine / vasopressors — high-alert drugs (independent double-check)
Tubing dead space — small dose errors могут быть significant
PO syringe не IV — wrong syringe = wrong route fatal
Look-alike/sound-alike drugs (morphine vs midazolam, dopamine vs dobutamine)
references: ISMP — Institute for Safe Medication Practices guidelines
AWHONN Standards for Professional Nursing Practice

steps.title: Indications
items: Late preterm + stable — daily 1+ hour sessions
Stable preterm < 32 нед — daily 30-60 min sessions
iKMC (immediate KMC) — даже unstable preterm в первые часы (WHO 2021)

steps.title: Preparation
items: Mother в comfortable chair с armrests
Infant в diaper только (or naked with hat)
Pre-warmed blanket для cover infant's back

steps.title: Positioning
items: Infant prone, head turned к side
Mother's hands support infant's bottom + back
Father / partner может также perform skin-to-skin

steps.title: Duration
items: Minimum 60 мин per session (transitions stress baby)
Long sessions (> 4 ч) — best для stable preterm
Father/partner sessions — equal benefits as mother (bonding + bonding hormones)

steps.title: End of session
items: Return к incubator с pre-warmed environment

warnings: Hypothermia если room cold or session ends abruptly
Apnea / bradycardia — terminate session if persistent
Mother / partner with fever / infection — defer until well
Excessive sweating mother — может change temperature
Mother's posture — back support critical (long sessions)
references: WHO Immediate KMC Study Group. NEJM 2021;384:2028 (iKMC)

steps.title: Pumping support
items: Personal flange size — NOT one-size-fits-all (proper fit critical)
Pump 8-12× per day mother's preterm milk supply
Sessions 15-20 мин per side OR until empty
Skin-to-skin sessions correlated with better milk supply

steps.title: Storage
items: Once thawed — must use within 24 h refrigerator (no re-freeze)
Microwave НЕ recommended (uneven heating + nutrient loss)

steps.title: Thawing
items: Discard если sour smell или curdled

steps.title: Fortification (preterm < 1500 g)
items: Add HMF (Human Milk Fortifier) при 80-100 мл/кг/d enteral
Use within 24 h refrigerator after fortification
Aliquot для each feed if pre-fortified

steps.title: Bottle feeding
items: Verify temperature на inner wrist (НЕ baby's mouth)

steps.title: Tube feeding (NG/OG)
items: Verify tube placement pH ≤ 5.5 BEFORE feeding
Bolus over 15-30 мин (gravity preferred over syringe push)
Position infant slightly upright × 30 мин post-feed

warnings: Preterm + CMV — donor milk pasteurized или freeze-thaw (Holder pasteurization eliminates)
Wrong identification — verify infant ID match milk label always
Bacterial contamination — sterile collection technique
Inadequate fortification — slow weight gain у VLBW
Excessive fortification — hypernatremia, dehydration risk

steps.title: Probe selection
items: Disposable Y-style preferred (better у unstable infants)
Avoid reusable hard plastic у preterm — pressure injury

steps.title: Placement
items: Pre-ductal: RIGHT hand or wrist (right radial artery — pre-PDA)
Avoid edematous, cold, или dark-pigmented sites

steps.title: Routine SpO₂ targets
items: Post-resuscitation: gradual increase per NRP minute-of-life curve

steps.title: Site rotation
items: Inspect skin under probe at rotation

steps.title: CCHD screening
items: Fail: < 90 %; persistent < 95 % после 3 measurements + 1 ч; ≥ 3 % difference

steps.title: Troubleshooting low signal
items: Crying / motion artifact → wait still period
Probe loose or wrong site → re-position

warnings: Pressure injuries / burns у preterm если probe slips или too tight
Methemoglobinemia / carboxyhemoglobinemia → falsely elevated SpO₂
Chronic intermittent hypoxemia (despite normal SpO₂) — adverse outcomes
Skin sloughing under probe — rare but documented у ELBW

steps.title: Initial setup
items: Pre-warm к target T 30-60 мин before infant arrival
Servo-control mode preferred (NOT manual / air mode)
Skin probe placement — abdomen, midline, away from bony prominences
Adhesive thin foam under probe (skin protection)
Humidity 60-80 % для ELBW первые 7 d (reduce TEWL)

steps.title: Servo settings
items: Air T fluctuates как needed для maintain skin T
AVOID manual mode у preterm (no auto-adjustment)
Alarm parameters: skin T ± 0.5 °C, air T 30-37 °C

steps.title: Humidity (ELBW first 7-14 d)
items: Distilled water только в reservoir (regular tap = scale)

steps.title: Hand hygiene + entry
items: Hand wash + use side-port doors (НЕ open lid frequently)
Document each entry в bedside log

steps.title: Skin probe maintenance
items: If displaces — replace immediately (servo failure → temperature drop)

steps.title: Wean to open crib
items: Stable T в air mode at 28-30 °C × 24-48 ч
Spend 1 day in incubator with door open
Then transition к open crib с swaddling

warnings: Skin probe displacement = servo failure → infant can overheat or chill
Manual mode у preterm — temperature instability
Inadequate humidity у ELBW → TEWL > 100 мл/кг/d → dehydration + electrolyte chaos
Excessive humidity > 90 % → bacterial growth, skin maceration
Frequent door opening → temperature drops (5-10 °C in seconds)
references: Sinclair JC. Cochrane 2002:CD001074 — Servo vs manual

steps.title: Approach по WHO 2017
items: Развитые страны: dry cord care — стандарт
Endemic / high-mortality settings: chlorhexidine 4 % gluconate (Imdad Cochrane 2013) — ↓ omphalitis + neonatal mortality
Никаких alcohol / antiseptic routinely в развитых странах

steps.title: Daily care
items: Avoid getting stump wet (sponge bath only)

steps.title: Когда concerning — alert physician
items: Stump > 4 weeks без falling off (delayed separation)

warnings: Hexachlorophene (banned routine — neurotoxic)
Iodine antiseptics — absorbed → hypothyroidism у newborn (avoid)
Tying or pulling stump — bleeding risk + infection
Omphalitis untreated → necrotizing fasciitis (rare — extremely high mortality)
references: AAP / AWHONN — Neonatal Skin Care 4th ed.

steps.title: Position changes q3-4h
items: Prone — only with continuous monitoring (NICU only — НЕ для home sleep!)

steps.title: Containment / facilitated tucking
items: Boundaries / nests (rolled blankets) — feeling of containment
Hand placement on infant's chest + bottom (gentle pressure)

steps.title: AVOID
items: Prolonged supine flat без turns (positional plagiocephaly)

warnings: SIDS risk у prone sleep после discharge — supine ALWAYS for home
Plagiocephaly (positional flat head) у prolonged single position
Torticollis у consistent head-turned-к-one-side
Hip dislocation risk у tight swaddling without natural hip flexion
Aspiration у improper positioning post-feed
references: Symington A, Pinelli J. Cochrane 2020:CD001814 — NIDCAP
AAP Task Force on SIDS. Pediatrics 2022;150:e2022057990

steps.title: Pre-transfusion verification
items: ID match: infant + blood product + medical record (independent двух RNs)

steps.title: Pre-transfusion baseline
items: Vital signs (HR, RR, BP, T, SpO₂)

steps.title: Administration
items: Slow rate: 5 мл/кг/h initially × 15 мин — observe для acute reaction
Then increase к target rate (complete в 2-4 ч usually)
Maintain warm: blood warmer if rate > 50 мл/h или у preterm < 1500 g
DON'T use IV pump для PRBC routine (can hemolyze) — use gravity или specialized blood pump

steps.title: Monitoring during
items: Vital signs q15 мин first 30 мин, then q30 мин

steps.title: Post-transfusion
items: Vital signs after completion + 1 ч later

steps.title: If reaction occurs
items: Send remaining blood + new sample for workup

warnings: Hemolytic reaction — life-threatening, often visible within first 15 мин
TACO у preterm — slow transfusion + diuretics may be needed
Hypothermia у unwarmed cold blood transfusion
Hyperkalemia от massive transfusion or stored blood
Citrate toxicity у large volume — hypocalcemia symptoms
references: Kirpalani H et al. NEJM 2020;383:2639 — TOP

steps.title: Stratum corneum maturation
items: Term: mature stratum corneum at birth

steps.title: Bathing / cleansing
items: Sponge bath only first 2 weeks у ELBW
Avoid bathing с soap у preterm < 30 нед
After cord falls + skin matures — gentle pH-neutral cleanser

steps.title: Adhesive use
items: Hydrocolloid barriers under tape (Mepilex Lite, DuoDERM)
Rotate sites q2-4h для probes / monitoring devices

steps.title: Topical agents
items: Chlorhexidine 0.5-2 % preferred antiseptic для procedures (NOT alcohol-based < 32 нед — burning)

steps.title: Diaper care
items: Gentle wipes (water + cotton); avoid alcohol/fragranced wipes

steps.title: Pressure injury prevention
items: ETT secure but not too tight
Soft surface (gel pads, foam underlay у ELBW)
Skin assessment q hour during initial NICU stay

steps.title: Cord care
items: Chlorhexidine 4 % cord — endemic / high-mortality settings (Imdad Cochrane 2013)

warnings: Skin breakdown у ELBW — high TEWL + permeability + adhesives
Iodine absorption → transient hypothyroidism у preterm
Topical absorption higher у preterm (chlorhexidine, alcohol)
Pressure injuries from probes / tape — frequent rotation
Diaper rash — fungal / irritant — early treatment
references: AAP / AWHONN. Neonatal Skin Care 4th ed.
Lund CH et al. JOGNN 2001;30:30 — RCT skin care

steps.title: Physiologic stability checklist
items: Stable temperature в открытой кроватке × 24-48 ч
Apnea-free ≥ 5-7 d (off caffeine 5-7 d if applicable)

steps.title: Required screenings complete
items: Hearing screen (ABR / OAE) passed или follow-up arranged
ROP exam если screened (preterm < 32 нед / BW < 1500 g)
Cranial UZI documented если preterm < 32 нед

steps.title: Vaccinations
items: RSV prophylaxis если applicable (palivizumab или nirsevimab)
Vaccine schedule documented + handed to parents

steps.title: Family education + demonstration
items: Symptoms recognition (lethargy, poor feeding, fever, jaundice)
Safe sleep (back position, firm mattress, no soft bedding)
Medication administration if on home meds
Home equipment if applicable (O₂, monitors, NG tube)

steps.title: Equipment / supplies
items: Car seat (test passed if preterm — chair test)

steps.title: Follow-up plan
items: High-risk follow-up clinic для VLBW / ELBW (developmental, OT, PT, audiology, ophthalmology)
Specialist appointments (cardiology, pulmonology, GI, neuro если indicated)
Social services / community resources contact info

steps.title: Medication reconciliation
items: List all home meds (dose, route, frequency)

warnings: Premature discharge у unstable infant — readmission rate ↑
Inadequate parent education → dangerous home situations
Missing vaccinations / screenings — long-term consequences
Failure to thrive если feeding не established before discharge
Unrecognized cardiac defect (если CCHD missed) — life-threatening
references: AAP COFN. Pediatrics 2008;122:1119 — Discharge of high-risk neonate
Engle WA AAP COFN. Pediatrics 2007;120:1390 — Late preterm discharge
